name: Timebank Global
subtitle: Give time. Get help. Connect.
promotionalText: Swap skills, earn time credits and connect with people in your local community. Everyone's time is valued equally.
description:
Timebank Global is where a community trades time instead of money. Give someone an hour of help and you earn an hour of credit, then spend it on help you need. Everyone's hour is worth the same, whatever the skill.

OFFER AND FIND HELP
Post what you can do, from gardening and lifts to IT help, language practice or a listening ear. Browse what neighbours are offering, ask for what you need, agree the details privately and record the hours when the exchange is complete.

YOUR TIME, TRACKED PROPERLY
Your wallet shows the hours you have earned and spent, with each exchange recorded on both sides. Time-credit exchanges do not involve money. An optional second-hand marketplace lets members arrange purchases of physical goods, with card payments handled by Stripe.

A COMMUNITY, NOT JUST A MARKETPLACE
Join local groups, attend events and workshops, follow your community feed and get to know the people you exchange with. Volunteering opportunities from local organisations sit alongside member offers, with shifts you can join and hours that count.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE
Timebank Global supports screen readers, system text sizing and dark mode. The app is available in English, Irish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish. You control who can see your profile, and account deletion is available inside the app.

OPEN AND INDEPENDENT
Timebank Global is free software under the AGPL-3.0 licence and does not sell personal data. Optional promotional notifications require explicit consent and can be switched off in the app. Essential payment, notification and crash-diagnostic services are disclosed in the Privacy Policy, and the source code is public.

A community may need to approve membership before a member can sign in. Members must be 18 or over to join.
